mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tbl_scout_offer_m ( company_sq,
resume_sq, project_sq, scout_offer_ttl, scout_offer_cnt, scout_offer_salary, scout_offer_status_cd, scout_offer_created_at_dtm, scout_offer_updated_at_dtm ) VALUES ( #{companySq}, #{resumeSq}, #{projectSq}, #{scoutOfferTtl}, #{scoutOfferCnt}, #{scoutOfferSalary}, COALESCE(#{scoutOfferStatusCd}, 'PENDING'), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT scout_offer_sq AS scoutOfferSq, company_sq AS companySq, resume_sq AS resumeSq, project_sq AS projectSq, scout_offer_ttl AS scoutOfferTtl, scout_offer_cnt AS scoutOfferCnt, scout_offer_salary AS scoutOfferSalary, scout_offer_status_cd AS scoutOfferStatusCd, scout_offer_created_at_dtm AS scoutOfferCreatedAtDtm, scout_offer_updated_at_dtm AS scoutOfferUpdatedAtDtm FROM tbl_scout_offer_m WHERE scout_offer_sq = #{scoutOfferSq}

SELECT so.scout_offer_sq AS scoutsSq, so.company_sq AS companySq, c.company_nm AS sendercompanyName, so.project_sq AS projectSq, p.project_ttl AS projectTitle, so.scout_offer_ttl AS title, so.scout_offer_cnt AS content, so.scout_offer_salary AS offeredPay, so.scout_offer_status_cd AS status, DATE_FORMAT(so.scout_offer_created_at_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(so.scout_offer_updated_at_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM tbl_scout_offer_m so LEFT JOIN tbl_company_s c ON so.company_sq = c.company_sq LEFT JOIN tbl_project_m p ON so.project_sq = p.project_sq WHERE so.scout_offer_sq = #{scoutSq}
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_scout_offer_m SET scout_offer_status_cd = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, scout_offer_updated_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE scout_offer_sq = #{scoutSq}
